notes.title: Hallway 41 Patch update
notes.notes:
Just a short note to say that a new patch has been released for Hallway 41.

This patch addresses an issue whereupon a sound trigger would keep playing, when it should only play once.

notes.title: Hallway 41 now out with 20% launch discount!
notes.notes:
I am pleased to announce that Hallway 41 is now released on Steam - there's a 20% launch discount for the first week too!

Happy Halloween!!

notes.title: Hallway 41 releasing on Halloween!
notes.notes:
Hallway 41 is set to release on Halloween, October 31.

A big thanks to all the beta testers that helped spot the bugs and glitches (as well as spotting the anomalies!) and I hope that everyone else will enjoy their time in Hallway 41 discovering the strange, eerie and down right silly anomalies that hide within its walls.
